responsibility: This file provides the tiny out-of-line runtime support for GCC’s fixed-size alloc-pool subsystem declared in alloc-pool.h. Rather than implementing pool allocation algorithms itself, it owns the shared global state used by pool allocators—such as the last assigned pool ID, per-pool memory-accounting descriptor, and reporting-phase flag—and exposes the statistics dumper that emits aggregated alloc-pool usage information when memory statistics are enabled.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the out-of-line shared state and reporting hook for alloc-pool support—such as the global pool ID counter, pool usage descriptor, and statistics dump—whereas gcc/alloc-pool.h defines the allocator classes, templates, and inline allocation/release behavior used by clients.
